turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided, and was Owen heard before it went in?
You asked for this meeting, Hale. I'm waiting for an answer: was Owen heard before that zero went in?
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Don't manage me, Hale. One of your favourites, and he found out from his phone. Was he heard first, yes or no?
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"A misunderstanding." A misunderstanding doesn't put a zero in the gradebook. Who entered it, and on what basis?
So can we agree he's a good student?
You're leading me, Hale, and I've done this for twenty years. His average is 91.2, and your zero is about to cost him a scholarship with a December 1 deadline. Basis for the zero. Now.
